blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: I'm Irish, but I don't speak Irish.
exercises.ru: Я ирландец, ___ не говорю по-ирландски.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Africa is a continent, but Greenland is not.
exercises.ru: Африка - материк, ___ Гренландия нет.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I hate mosquitoes, but they seem to love me.
exercises.ru: Я ненавижу москитов, ___, кажется, они любят меня.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: There was no Kievan Rus', but there was a Kievan Ukraine.
exercises.ru: Не было никакой Киевской Руси, ___ была Киевская Украина.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I can scroll down with my mouse, but not up.
exercises.ru: Я могу прокручивать мышкой вниз, ___ не вверх.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The notebook is not yours. It's his.
exercises.ru: Тетрадь не твоя, ___ его.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: He's not only deaf and mute, but also blind.
exercises.ru: Он не только глухонемой, ___ ещё и слепой.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Deep-sea fish often look ugly, but they taste good.
exercises.ru: Глубоководные рыбы часто страшные на вид, ___ вкусные.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Do you have some kind of backup airfield?
exercises.ru: ___ запасной аэродром у вас какой?
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Cut down that dead tree, or it will fall down on your house.
exercises.ru: Сруби это усохшее дерево, ___ иначе оно упадёт на твой дом.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: He's not tall, but strong.
exercises.ru: Он невысокий, ___ сильный.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: When Vin Diesel does pushups, he's not pushing himself up - he's pushing the Earth down.
exercises.ru: Когда Вин Дизель отжимается, он не поднимает себя, ___ опускает Землю.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: He did his best, but in vain.
exercises.ru: Он старался вовсю, ___ тщетно.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Some people don't like overcast weather, but I find it comforting.
exercises.ru: Некоторым не нравится, когда пасмурно, ___ меня это успокаивает.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Is there a clause in the lease regarding that?
exercises.ru: ___ в договоре об аренде есть пункт, предусматривающий это?
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom isn't a doctor, but a nurse.
exercises.ru: Том не врач, ___ медбрат.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: This sentence has a predicate but no subject.
exercises.ru: В этом предложении есть сказуемое, ___ нет подлежащего.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: He is poor, but honest.
exercises.ru: Он бедный, ___ честный.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: And he calls himself a sniper!
exercises.ru: ___ ещё снайпером называется!
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Take your time. It's a marathon, not a sprint.
exercises.ru: Не торопись. Это марафон, ___ не спринт.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
